hooks.command:
cat <<'DORA'
[DORA] Practices active. Before writing code:
  1. Load the relevant DORA skill (see CLAUDE.md router table)
  2. Write the failing test FIRST (load test-driven-development)
  3. Work on a feature branch, not main
  4. Commit after each passing change — do not batch
  5. Run dora-review agent after completing changes
DORA
echo '[DORA] Writing code — is there a failing test for this change? If not, write the test first.'
echo '[DORA] If committing: one logical change per commit. If pushing: push to feature branch, not main.'
echo '[DORA] Checkpoint — did you: commit after passing changes? push to branch? load the relevant skill?'
